user_requirements.text: Carry the measured electric toothbrush with its head attached

source.statement: User measured 250–255 mm overall, nearly cylindrical 30 mm handle, 165 mm handle and 90 mm shoulder-to-tip

user_requirements.text: Carry toothpaste on its own side with room for tube variation

source.statement: User measured a new tube about 160 x 55 x 40 mm with 30 mm cap and requested margins for other versions

user_requirements.text: Use a compliant printed design without a separate TPU print

source.statement: User requested compliance and preferably no separately printed TPU part

user_requirements.text: Provide a small or simplified fit test that is easy and quick to print alongside the full model

source.statement: User authorized both the small fit test and complete model in one phase
